name: Studiola
summary: A bold workspace for a small creative studio: jobs and tasks, room bookings, people and invoices
about: A complete task and project app for a small creative team, with its people, jobs, room bookings and invoices, drawn in a bold block style with thick ink lines. A live floor plan shows which rooms are in use, and a time scrubber lets you look at any hour of the day. Good for design studios, video and photo studios, agencies and makers who share rooms.
how: Studio shows the floor plan: busy rooms light up in colour. Drag the scrubber to see the studio at any hour, or press Now to go live.
On Jobs, open a job to see its tasks, tick tasks off, add new ones inline and click a task name for its drawer with files and comments.
On Rooms, drag a booking along the day or up and down to another room, drag its right edge to resize, or click an empty slot to book. Clashes bounce back.
People shows who is in, their skills and weekly hours. Change someone's status or send them a quick message.
On Invoices, build an invoice line by line, pull logged hours from a job, send it, chase overdue ones and mark them paid.
Clients keeps contacts and history. Settings has studio details, rates, room names, the theme and Reset demo data.
